This skill generates printable A4 packing lists (装箱单) for Chinese foreign-trade exports, with a focus on the drawstring-bag (束口袋) industry. It parses packing-list content (structured JSON or pasted free text or emails), automatically identifies the sales platform (Amazon FBA, Alibaba.com, AliExpress, Made-in-China.com, generic), applies the platform-specific A4 layout and field template, and exports a print-ready A4 document (self-contained HTML, optional PDF via headless Chrome). Use it when a user asks to create, print, or export a packing list, 装箱单, or shipping-box label sheet for cross-border e-commerce, or to convert order or email text into a standardized packing list.
